model_version: 2025 xteNCAM assessment under the 2023 framework; detailed report published as DFO Research Document 2026/026
notes: Newest production assessment represented here with detailed public sources for one run. Inputs extend through 2024 and selected estimates through 2025; the run uses xteNCAM under the 2023 framework, with its detailed report published in April 2026. Numerical data recorded include commercial catch numbers-at-age (Table 4), fall RV indices (Table 7), stock and catch weights (Tables 9-10), cohort maturity (Table 8), and selected SSB, age-0 recruitment, and F/M outputs. The catch-at-age table is retained as reported counts; total and gear-specific landings are omitted, and no proportion-to-count conversion was needed. Inputs and outputs remain partial: stock weights after 2008, other survey series, mapped calendar-year maturity, and age-specific population outputs are incomplete. M is estimated within the model, not supplied. Exact fall-survey dates are unavailable, so timing is approximated as 0.75. The 2026 assessment summary to 2026 is not entered because full input and output series for that run are not available.

model_version: The 2024 assessment to 2023 reused the SCA model adopted in 2012 and updated through 2019; detailed model-fit report covers data through 2018.
notes: This is the 2024 production assessment to 2023; the 2019 detailed model report remains a separate assessment record. The database now includes the published 1950-2023 SSB, under-age-4 recruitment, and grouped F/M output series from the 2024 rebuilding plan. For 2023 SSB, the assessment report's direct estimate and interval (12 kt; 10.5-21.6) are retained; the rebuilding-plan table reports 11.9 kt (7.8-16.5). Updated age compositions, survey observations, weight and maturity inputs remain untranscribed.

The 2019 SCA fit covers 1950-2018 and ages 2-12+. Its likelihood uses annual total catch, age-aggregated survey indices, and proportions-at-age. The 480 Table 3 values recorded here are reported landings-at-age for 1971-2018, ages 3-12+, across 4T, 4Vn (November-April), and 4Vs (January-April); they are not the complete model likelihood inputs. Table 8 maturity ogives are recorded as 759 annual age rows, carried forward between source-listed change years without interpolation; the table does not specify sex. Total annual catch, age proportions, survey observations, stock weights, and model outputs remain incomplete.
